scope: Fuel budget hierarchy, pre-build availability, source attribution and copy. No new consumption rates or compatibility changes.

verification.model_tests: PASS: 22 tests, including reserve arithmetic and availability states
browser: Default kettle charcoal: initial-load-only notice visible before build
Kettle 57 cm, briquettes, indirect, 4 hours: preview and result show total 68 = initial 30 + replenishment 24 + reserve 14
Kettle smoking: no automatic budget notice appears before generation; result explicitly says quantity unavailable
Pellets baking, 4 hours: headline range 2.3–9 kg; conservative budget 11.3 kg is secondary and separated from reserve
390px mobile kettle result: readable breakdown, no horizontal overflow
Browser error log empty during this verification

preserved_limitations: No automatic session consumption for charcoal, direct briquettes, kettle smoking, stages, gas, kamado, vertical or offset without a user-provided measured rate
Stage editor simplification and automatic duration aggregation are deferred
Weber quantities remain manufacturer-specific; Lumbre reserve is a planning margin, not a Weber guarantee
deployment: Local only; no push or deployment
